description: LLM knowledge units of the 480 rows of the FedIT-FL Shapley reference set (Dolly-15k, original release, split_seed 0, 60 rows per category). Topic (what the text is about), not task type: the native Dolly categories are a separate control axis. Rules are applied in order; the first that fits decides.
labeller: Claude (Anthropic), in the project conversation of 2026-10-20, from the instruction plus the first ~90 characters of the context and the first ~60 characters of the response of each row (PROMPT.md)
rules: Sports teams, athletes, games played outdoors, hiking, camping, fishing and college mascots go to sports_outdoors, even when the question is historical.
Music, musicians, painting, sculpture, theatre, dance and photography go to music_arts; novels, poetry, film, TV, comics and video games go to stories_media.
Food, cooking, drinks, diet, medicine, disease, fitness and the body go to health_food.
Countries, cities, landmarks, travel and physical geography go to places_travel; the history or politics of a place goes to history_society.
Anything about companies, products as businesses, money, jobs, careers and marketing goes to business_work.
Personal advice, household, relationships, pets, hobbies without a sport, riddles and common-sense or word puzzles go to everyday_life.
Classification and extraction tasks are labelled by the topic of their items (a list of animals is nature_science).

units.definition: animals, plants, the natural world and natural sciences, including mathematics and astronomy
technology, engineering, computing, software, vehicles, machines and materials
health, medicine, the body, food, cooking, drinks and fitness
countries, cities, landmarks, geography and travel
stories, books, writing, film, TV, games and other entertainment media
sports, athletes, teams, outdoor recreation and college mascots
history, politics, law, society, religion, philosophy, culture and biographies outside sports and the arts
business, companies, economics, money, work, careers and marketing
everyday life, personal matters, home, relationships, pets, hobbies, common-sense and word puzzles
music, musicians and the visual and performing arts
